name: Weather-based discount
description:
This design adds a 10 percent offer-level discount granted while it rains or snows in Warsaw ([Discount in bad weather](noesis:need|rain-discount)), and prepares the model for further weather-based discounts ([Further weather discounts](noesis:need|further-weather-discounts)).

# Where it lands

- The new [weather](noesis:module|discounts.weather) module holds the current weather, as a condition a discount can depend on.
- The new [openmeteo](noesis:module|discounts.weather.openmeteo) module inside it holds the Open-Meteo service as the source of that weather.
- The existing calculation module gains the new discounts and carries the weather to them.

# Where to start reading

1. [WeatherProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.weather.WeatherProvider) is the port: [getCurrent](noesis:behavior|discounts.weather.WeatherProvider.getCurrent) gives a [Weather](noesis:building_block|discounts.weather.Weather) snapshot, precipitation in millimetres, or says the weather is unknown.
2. [OpenMeteoWeatherProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.weather.openmeteo.OpenMeteoWeatherProvider) implements it; any failure of the API means unknown weather, never an error in discount calculation ([Pricing without weather](noesis:need|pricing-without-weather)).
3. [DiscountPolicyFactory.get](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.DiscountPolicyFactory.get) reads the weather once per policy resolution (spec, rule 4) and puts it into [Conditions](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.Conditions), which gains the optional weather.
4. [PotentialPrecipitationDiscount.isApplicableFor](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PotentialPrecipitationDiscount.isApplicableFor) holds exactly when the known precipitation is above 0 mm (spec, rule 1); unknown weather grants nothing (spec, rule 2). [Its discount](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PotentialPrecipitationDiscount.getDiscount) is a [PercentageDiscount](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.PercentageDiscount) of 10 percent.

# Around them

- [PercentageDiscount.apply](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.PercentageDiscount.apply) records one offer-level discount amount; weather discounts stack with every other discount (spec, rule 3).
- [DiscountPolicyFactory](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountPolicyFactory) gains the weather port. [DiscountsConfigProvider](noesis:building_block|discounts.calculation.DiscountsConfigProvider) registers the precipitation discount next to the VIP discount in [getDiscountsConfig](noesis:behavior|discounts.calculation.DiscountsConfigProvider.getDiscountsConfig).

# Left for later

- Further weather discounts: a field on `Weather`, a parameter in the adapter and a potential discount registered in the configuration (spec, Extension recipe).
- Caching, retries and a configurable location (spec, Scope).

added.name: Percentage discount is an offer-level discount recorded as a discount amount

description.value: A percentage discount holds a percentage value and, when applied, appends exactly one DiscountAmount referencing itself to the offer-level discounts of the DiscountedOffer, leaving product-level discounts untouched. It follows the same shape as FixedDiscount; no money computation happens in this iteration.
description.author: agent

added.name: Weather discounts stack with other discounts

description.value: A weather-based discount neither excludes any other discount nor is excluded by one; a VIP user in the rain receives both the VIP fixed discount and the precipitation discount. Exclusivity is only introduced if a configurator wraps the discount in the existing ExclusiveOfferLevelDiscount.

added.name: Precipitation above zero makes the precipitation discount applicable

description.value: The discount is applicable exactly when the conditions carry a known weather snapshot whose precipitation is strictly greater than 0 mm. Precipitation equal to 0 is dry weather and yields no discount. The threshold is a business constant of this discount, not of the weather provider.

diagram.value:
sequenceDiagram
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>UserStatusProvider: getFor(userId)
  UserStatusProvider-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: UserStatus
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>WeatherProvider: getCurrent()
  WeatherProvider-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: Option<Weather>
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>DiscountsConfigProvider: getDiscountsConfig()
  DiscountsConfigProvider-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: DiscountConfig
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>Conditions: build(userStatus, weather)
  DiscountPolicyFactory->>DiscountConfig: getDiscountsForConditions(conditions)
  DiscountConfig->>PotentialPrecipitationDiscount: isApplicableFor(conditions)
  DiscountConfig-->>DiscountPolicyFactory: List<Discount>
